<students>

        <name>John Doe</name>
        <citizenship>USA</citizenship>
        <age>25</age>
    </student>
    <student>

        <password>bspassword</password>

        <citizenship>Canada</citizenship>
        <age>22</age>
    </student>
</students>`;

const result = getStudentInfo(xml_data, 'john_doe', 'jdpassword');
